description: Use the released organization preset while retaining development-container coverage.

packageRules.description: A capability-verifier workflow bump has to regenerate verifications/*.lock.json in the same PR. Hosted Mend Renovate does not run postUpgradeTasks without a self-hosted allowedCommands allowlist, which this app does not grant.
prBodyNotes: Hosted Mend Renovate does not run the lock generator on this repository (`allowedCommands` is self-hosted only, and this app has no allowlist). Check out this branch, run `python3 tools/lock.py --update`, and commit the result with a `fix:` or `chore:` prefix. That rewrites tag, commit and digest in all four `verifications/*.lock.json` files from this workflow pin. Do not hand-edit those fields.
